infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: My Salon In uses your location to show nearby beauty professionals and salons in your area.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: My Salon In needs camera access to upload your profile photo and portfolio images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: My Salon In needs photo library access to choose your profile and portfolio images.
